name: A Joint Analysis of BICEP2/Keck Array and Planck Data

official_url.quote: A Joint Analysis of BICEP2/Keck Array and Planck Data

significance.quote: Marginalizing over dust and $r$, lensing $B$-modes are detected at $7.0\,\sigma$ significance.

summary.plain: A joint analysis of BICEP2/Keck Array and Planck data found that the polarization excess reported by BICEP2 in 2014 was largely due to dust in our galaxy. It left only an upper limit on primordial gravitational waves.
summary.technical: Joint BICEP2/Keck Array + Planck (30-353 GHz) fit to lensed-LCDM + dust + r: 150x353 GHz cross-correlation in B modes detected at high significance; r_0.05 < 0.12 at 95%; lensing B modes detected at 7.0 sigma.

title: A Joint Analysis of BICEP2/Keck Array and Planck Data
why_it_matters: It resolved the status of the BICEP2 B-mode excess: strong evidence for dust, no statistically significant evidence for primordial tensor modes.
